description: Source file defining the DotpromptManager class which integrates custom prompt management with LiteLLM's prompt system, enabling handling of .prompt files, rendering prompts with variables, converting to chat messages, and interfacing with prompt templates and directories.

classes.name: DotpromptManager
classes.description: A prompt management class that extends CustomPromptManagement, integrating with LiteLLM to support .prompt files, rendering, and conversion to chat messages, with methods for prompt compilation, async handling, and prompt management interface.
